## Data Product Overview
This report visualises prescribing activity and associated costs for Out of Hours (OOH) care services, including item volumes, drug categories, and contractor-level breakdowns. It highlights trends in OOH prescribing across practices and regions, providing insight into demand and financial impact. The report is available via ePACT2 for authorised users and Catalyst for aggregated insights, supporting transparency and service planning.

Purpose:
The report helps NHS England, commissioners, and contractors monitor OOH prescribing patterns, identify high-demand areas, and ensure prescribing aligns with clinical and cost-effectiveness standards. It supports resource allocation and formulary compliance.

How to Use:
Users can filter by practice, contractor, or region to review OOH prescribing activity, compare trends, and identify opportunities for optimisation. Commissioners use it for audit, financial planning, and prescribing efficiency programmes, while prescribers and contractors can track their own activity and ensure adherence to best practice. Public users can view aggregated insights to understand OOH prescribing trends and expenditure.
